title: Stepping into the Future
sub: Buku pendamping Bahasa Inggris Kelas 12 SMA/MA
intro:
📌 Capaian Pembelajaran Fase F (ringkas)
  • Berkomunikasi secara efektif untuk keperluan akademik dan dunia kerja (lamaran, wawancara, presentasi).
  • Menganalisis dan menghasilkan teks news item, hortatory exposition, discussion, dan surat formal.
  • Melaporkan ucapan orang lain dengan tepat dan mengevaluasi argumen dari berbagai sudut pandang.
cando: Menulis hortatory exposition dengan rekomendasi yang jelas.
Menulis discussion text dengan dua sudut pandang.
Menjawab pertanyaan wawancara dan menyampaikan presentasi yang runtut.

goals: Memahami struktur job application letter dan curriculum vitae (CV).

sections.html:
WE ARE HIRING!
Junior Graphic Designer — Kreasi Nusantara Studio, Yogyakarta
Requirements: vocational/senior high school graduate or higher · skilled in design software · creative and able to work in a team · basic English communication.
Benefits: competitive salary, health insurance, training.
Send your application letter, CV, and portfolio to hr@kreasinusantara.id before 31 October 2026.

sections.title: Job vacancy

sections.html:
Jl. Kaliurang Km 5, Yogyakarta
20 October 2026
HR Manager
Kreasi Nusantara Studio
Yogyakarta

Dear Sir or Madam,

I am writing to apply for the position of Junior Graphic Designer, which was advertised on your Instagram account on 15 October 2026.

I graduated from SMA Negeri 3 Yogyakarta this year. During school, I was the head of design for the school magazine, and I have created more than fifty posters and social media designs for school events. I have also completed an online course in graphic design. I am confident that my creativity and teamwork skills would make me a valuable member of your team.

I have enclosed my CV and portfolio for your consideration. I would welcome the opportunity to attend an interview at your convenience.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Yours faithfully,
Dimas Arya Saputra

sections.title: News item
paras:
Students Turn Plastic Waste into Paving Blocks
SURABAYA — A group of senior high school students in Surabaya has developed paving blocks made from recycled plastic waste. The innovation was presented at a national science fair in Jakarta on Monday (5/10).

The four students from SMA Harapan Bangsa said that each block contained about 40 percent shredded plastic mixed with sand. According to their tests, the blocks are lighter than ordinary concrete blocks but just as strong for walkways.
“We collected the plastic from our school canteen and nearby markets,” explained Laila, the team leader. “If our idea is used widely, tonnes of plastic will be kept out of rivers every month.”
The city environmental agency stated that it would test the blocks for public parks next year. The students are now looking for partners to produce the blocks on a larger scale.

goals: Memakai modal should, must, need to, ought to untuk rekomendasi.

sections.title: Hortatory exposition
paras:
Teenagers Should Limit Their Screen Time
Smartphones have become a big part of teenagers' lives. They help us study, communicate, and relax. However, many students now spend more than seven hours a day on screens outside school. This habit needs to be controlled.
First, too much screen time affects our health. Looking at screens late at night disturbs sleep, and sitting for hours can cause back pain and weight problems.
Second, it reduces our focus. Constant notifications train the brain to switch tasks quickly, so it becomes harder to concentrate on reading or solving problems.
Third, it takes time away from real-life relationships. Families eating together while everyone looks at a phone are not really together.

Therefore, teenagers should limit their recreational screen time to about two hours a day. Parents must set a good example, and schools ought to teach digital wellbeing. Let's put our phones down and look up at the world around us.

goals: Memahami discussion text yang menyajikan dua sudut pandang.
Memakai kata penghubung pertentangan: however, on the other hand, whereas, although, despite.

sections.title: Discussion text
paras:
Online Learning: Pros and Cons
Since the pandemic, online learning has become common in Indonesia. Some people believe it is the future of education, whereas others think it cannot replace the classroom.

Supporters argue that online learning is flexible. Students can study anytime and replay lessons they do not understand. It also gives students in remote areas access to courses from top teachers. In addition, it trains digital skills that are needed in the modern workplace.

On the other hand, critics point out several problems. Not all students have stable internet or suitable devices. Learning alone at home requires strong self-discipline, and many students feel lonely without classmates. Moreover, practical subjects such as chemistry experiments or sports are difficult to teach online.

In conclusion, online learning has clear advantages and disadvantages. Perhaps the best solution is blended learning, which combines the flexibility of online study with the human interaction of face-to-face classes.
